description: Read one Artifact: title, who can open it, the Version viewers see (published_version_id, null while a publication is still being prepared), its URL, and for a markdown document its text (content), so a linked document is read in one call. Pass the art_… id from the end of the link.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact id (art_…): the last part of its link, as in bisque.cloud/documents/art_…, /pages/art_… or /artifacts/art_….

name: get_artifact

audience_mode.description: Who can open it: owner, users, org, or public.

content.description: The Markdown source of a markdown Artifact's published Version. null for an html page, a presentation, an Artifact that is not yet published, or a sold one you only view.

icon_image_url.description: The page icon set with icon_image; null for the Bisque icon.

published_version_id.description: The Version viewers see; null until a publication is ready.

title: Get an Artifact
